description: Call the unified SorryCode Images API to generate or edit images.

interface.longDescription: SorryCode Image2 wraps the SorryCode Images API for gpt-image-2. It checks SORRYCODE_API_KEY, writes request diagnostics, and saves generated images under outputs/images/.
